mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE MENU_TREE AS ( SELECT M.MENU_NUMB , CAST(CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(M.SORT_ORDR, 9999) AS CHAR), 50, '0') , '-' , LPAD(CAST(M.MENU_NUMB AS CHAR), 20, '0')) AS CHAR(1000)) AS TREE_PATH FROM TM_URMENU M WHERE M.PARN_NUMB IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT CHILD.MENU_NUMB , CONCAT(PARENT.TREE_PATH , '/' , LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(CHILD.SORT_ORDR, 9999) AS CHAR), 50, '0') , '-' , LPAD(CAST(CHILD.MENU_NUMB AS CHAR), 20, '0')) AS TREE_PATH FROM TM_URMENU CHILD JOIN MENU_TREE PARENT ON PARENT.MENU_NUMB = CHILD.PARN_NUMB )

M.MENU_NUMB , M.PARN_NUMB , P.MENU_NAME AS PARN_NAME , M.MENU_LEVL , M.MENU_NAME , M.MENU_URLX , M.SORT_ORDR , M.SHOW_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, M.SHOW_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}) AS SHOW_YSNO_NAME , M.USEE_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, M.USEE_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}) AS USEE_YSNO_NAME , M.REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(M.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , M.REGI_DATE , M.UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(M.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , M.UPDT_DATE
mapper.select:
SELECT /* getUserMenuList */ PAGE.MENU_NUMB , PAGE.PARN_NUMB , PAGE.PARN_NAME , PAGE.MENU_LEVL , PAGE.MENU_NAME , PAGE.MENU_URLX , PAGE.SORT_ORDR , PAGE.SHOW_YSNO , PAGE.SHOW_YSNO_NAME , PAGE.USEE_YSNO , PAGE.USEE_YSNO_NAME , PAGE.REGI_ADMN , PAGE.REGI_ADMN_NAME , PAGE.REGI_DATE , PAGE.UPDT_ADMN , PAGE.UPDT_ADMN_NAME , PAGE.UPDT_DATE FROM ( SELECT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TREE.TREE_PATH) AS ROW_NUMB FROM MENU_TREE TREE JOIN TM_URMENU M ON M.MENU_NUMB = TREE.MENU_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_URMENU P ON P.MENU_NUMB = M.PARN_NUMB WHERE 1 = 1
) PAGE WHERE PAGE.ROW_NUMB BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY PAGE.ROW_NUMB
SELECT /* getUserMenuCount */ COUNT(1) FROM TM_URMENU M WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT /* getUserMenuDtl */
FROM TM_URMENU M LEFT JOIN TM_URMENU P ON P.MENU_NUMB = M.PARN_NUMB WHERE M.MENU_NUMB = #{menuNumb}

SELECT /* getUserMenuParentList */
FROM MENU_TREE TREE JOIN TM_URMENU M ON M.MENU_NUMB = TREE.MENU_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_URMENU P ON P.MENU_NUMB = M.PARN_NUMB WHERE M.MENU_LEVL < 3 ORDER BY TREE.TREE_PATH
SELECT /* getUserMenuChildCount */ COUNT(1) FROM TM_URMENU WHERE PARN_NUMB = #{menuNumb}

WITH RECURSIVE DESCENDANT_MENU AS ( SELECT MENU_NUMB , 1 AS TREE_DEPT FROM TM_URMENU WHERE PARN_NUMB = #{menuNumb} UNION ALL SELECT CHILD.MENU_NUMB , PARENT.TREE_DEPT + 1 AS TREE_DEPT FROM TM_URMENU CHILD JOIN DESCENDANT_MENU PARENT ON PARENT.MENU_NUMB = CHILD.PARN_NUMB ) SELECT /* getUserMenuDescendantDepth */ COALESCE(MAX(TREE_DEPT), 0) FROM DESCENDANT_MENU

WITH RECURSIVE DESCENDANT_MENU AS ( SELECT MENU_NUMB FROM TM_URMENU WHERE PARN_NUMB = #{menuNumb} UNION ALL SELECT CHILD.MENU_NUMB FROM TM_URMENU CHILD JOIN DESCENDANT_MENU PARENT ON PARENT.MENU_NUMB = CHILD.PARN_NUMB ) SELECT /* getUserMenuDescendantCount */ COUNT(1) FROM DESCENDANT_MENU WHERE MENU_NUMB = #{candidateNumb}
